title: Q14 Sequence of statements on taming atomic energy
subject: Environment
caption: Flowchart showing the logical sequence of statements P, Q, R, S leading to peaceful or conflict outcomes in atomic energy use.
altText: A flowchart begins with a Start node, proceeds through four sequential statements labeled P through S, then reaches a decision diamond asking if the usage is peaceful. If yes, it follows to an outcome node describing sustainable energy for society; if no, it leads to an outcome node indicating potential for conflict. Both outcomes converge to an End node. Nodes are color‑coded: start and end in pink, decision in yellow, and process steps in light blue.
